forecast: Sharp reflex bounce off 688 already ran to 695.6 on heavy volume; expect a stall/chop in the 695-702 zone over the next 2-4 bars, then either a failed-bounce rollover or a break of 688 that resumes the downtrend toward ~680.
expectancy_note: No positive-expectancy entry now: shorting RSI 13.6 into a live squeeze is the account's #1 loser (bounce hits the stop), and the bounce itself is a countertrend pop into a risk-off tape with NFP gap risk - neither side clears R:R>=1.5 with an honest stop.
rationale: QQQ is deeply oversold (4h RSI 13.6, ADX 93) and just V-bounced off 688.09 on the two largest green bars of the window, so a market-short would be chasing into the snap-back and a long would be fading a risk-off downtrend into overhead resistance near VWAP. The dominant trend is down (1h/4h short, rel-strength -6.8%, orderbook -0.831) but the immediate impulse is up, so the clean trade is to wait for the bounce to resolve. Losing the 688 low reasserts the downtrend with room to ~680 and is the highest-information trigger to re-engage the short; a reclaim above ~700 would instead argue the oversold bounce has legs.

reconsider.note: Losing the 688.09 bounce low fails the oversold V and resumes the semis-led downtrend with room toward 680 - re-engage short there.
